correctness.rationale: For f=A+Bt+C cos t+E sin t, four distinct zeros in any interval of length ≤2π force three zeros of f′, impossible unless their span reaches 2π, and equality leads only to double endpoint contacts; the confluent Wronskian of {1,t,cos,sin} is positive. Exact paired determinant D=4 sin h sin k H shows near h=k=0,d=2π its leading sign is −2π(d−2π), with positive quartic correction at d=2π; compactness and endpoint multiplicities localize all sign reversals near the two endpoint doublets. After t=(εx1,εx2,2π+εx3,2π+εx4), determinant leading homogeneous term π ε³(x1−x2)(x3−x4)(x1+x2−x3−x4) fixes the bounded limiting R. Integrating R in midpoint and half-gap variables with Jacobian 4 gives volume 1/6, and ordered-sampling density 24/L⁴ yields ε⁴/(4π⁴). The rescaled conditional densities converge a.e. and integrate to one, so Scheffe gives total variation; marginal ∫ produces 12a(1−a)². Independent direct determinant ratios tended to 1 for positive/negative test vectors at ε=.1,.03,.01. Finite samples do not prove compactness or TV; analytic argument provides these.
